# Open Privacy Suite

> A privacy-preserving JSON-RPC gateway for shared EVM blockchains: multiple
> organizations transact on one chain while the proxy enforces who may see
> and do what — per-org contract isolation, per-viewer redaction of
> transactions and explorer data, function/parameter-level access rules,
> consent-based disclosure grants, and an append-only tamper-evident audit
> trail. Users authenticate with ZK credentials (Privado ID), SSO, or wallet
> linking, then use standard JSON-RPC tooling with an auth header.

Key facts: the chain itself is not encrypted — privacy is enforced at the
access layer, so production deployments must make the proxy the only path to
the node. The operator of the proxy is trusted; the guarantees are between
users and organizations. Repository: https://github.com/LFDT-Permissioned-Privacy-Control/permissioned-privacy-control
— it ships a one-command seeded demo (`make quickstart`: two banks + a
regulator with ready-to-use tokens; see ONBOARDING.md) and an MCP server
(`mcp/`, ~94 tools) so AI agents can drive the product directly.

## Features

- [RBAC — orgs, groups, claims, contract grants](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/rbac/)
- [Security model — request filtering, cross-org isolation](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/security/)
- [Response filtering / redaction](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/security/response-filtering/)
- [Privacy requirements and boundaries](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/security/privacy-requirements/)
- [Selective disclosure — consent-based grants](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/disclosure/)
- [Compliance — KYC gating, travel rule](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/compliance/)
- [Privacy-filtered block explorer](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/explorer/)
- [Authentication — ZK proofs, SSO, wallet linking](https://lfdt-permissioned-privacy-control.github.io/permissioned-privacy-control/docs/authentication/)
